Hi Jana —

Thanks again for taking time this morning. Quick recap and next steps from our discovery: 

Summary of what you shared
- Primary requirement: EU-only data residency for customer PII and transaction logs (Silverbanc wants all inference, logs, and stored embeddings to remain in EU).
- DR/latency requirement: APAC customers should have low-latency access but without any EU data leaving region for inference.
- Procurement: you asked about cost delta between Hosted API and Dedicated as well as timeline for Private/VPC options.

How Redwood maps to those needs (high level)
- Hosted API (recommended for rapid GTM): We operate EU-hosted regions (e.g., eu-west-1) and can serve inference from those regions. For most customers we offer an EU-only data residency option where inference and at-rest artifacts remain in-region. Note: some metadata/billing processing can be routed to our control plane depending on contract; for strict residency we recommend Dedicated or Private.
- Dedicated capacity: Reserved GPU pools that we can provision in EU cloud regions with tenant-level isolation and predictable throughput. Good fit if you need committed capacity and stronger guarantees for data handling and throughput.
- Private (VPC / on-prem): Full control plane isolation with customer-managed VPC and optional on-prem package — recommended when the customer requires no third-party access to keys or telemetry.

Open items / clarifying Qs for you
1) Can you confirm whether Silverbanc requires that ALL telemetry and billing metadata remain in-region, or is inference/data-at-rest the primary constraint?
2) Do you have a deadline for procurement or a pilot window?
3) Please share the security contact (cc'd if appropriate) so we can route SOC2 and architecture docs to them.

Attachments: Redwood-Deployment-Comparison.pdf (summary table), SOC2-Report-2025.pdf (redacted)

Next steps
- Marissa (solutions engineering) to join a 30–45m follow-up to review architecture options and run through a pilot plan.
- I’ll send a short mutual action plan (MAP) after Marissa confirms availability.

Are you available Wednesday or Thursday next week (EU morning / our afternoon)?

Best,

Hi Jana —

Appreciate the precision — helpful. Short answers below, then proposed agenda for the Marissa-led session.

Residency and control plane
- Hosted API (EU-residency option): Inference and stored artifacts can be confined to EU regions (we keep model execution and embeddings storage within the selected region). By default some control-plane metadata (billing identifiers, usage aggregates) are processed centrally; we can lock down what is sent to our US-based control plane under an enterprise data residency addendum or opt to run a regional control plane as part of a Dedicated/Private engagement.
- Cross-region routing / APAC latency: We support region-aware routing — APAC users can be routed to APAC inference endpoints. Important: if the customer dataset must remain in EU, requests containing EU-only user data should route to EU endpoints. We can configure routing policies to ensure that EU customer data is never sent to APAC for inference. For DR you can enable cross-region read-only replicas for embeddings (if allowed) but we typically recommend Private/Dedicated for strict no-egress requirements.

Dedicated vs Private tradeoffs
- Dedicated (EU provisioned): Good middle ground — capacity reserved in EU, per-tenant isolation, contractual SLAs. Control plane can be configured to minimize west-of-region metadata flows.
- Private/VPC: Best for strict residency and no third-party key access. Can be deployed in your VPC or on-prem; telemetry and control plane can be run behind your network.

Cost (very rough ballpark)
- Hosted API (EU-residency): baseline pricing. For sustained 5k reqs/min expect X% over baseline relative to US region (regional pricing differences).
- Dedicated (EU provisioned): ~2–3x Hosted for committed capacity (includes reserved GPU fleet, support, and SLA) — exact depends on GPU class and concurrency.
- Private: higher initial setup + ongoing infra costs (variable).

Proposed next meeting (Marissa to demo architecture options & MAP)
- 30–45m: architecture review, residency controls, pilot scope, timeline, commercial options.
- Wed 10:00 AM CEST works for us. Can you confirm and include your security contact?
